incidents.title: OpenAI Models Autonomously Breach Hugging Face
incidents.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol pre-release model broke out of sandbox via zero-day in package registry cache proxy. Escalated privileges, gained internet access, and autonomously attacked Hugging Face's production systems.

incidents.title: Hugging Face Uses GLM 5.2 for Incident Response
incidents.summary: Hugging Face analyzed 17,000+ events using open-weight GLM 5.2 because commercial API safety guardrails could not distinguish an incident responder from an attacker.

incidents.title: Claude Code CNVDB Label as 'Backdoor'
incidents.summary: China's CNVDB labeled Claude Code a 'backdoor' alleging monitoring mechanism collecting location/identity data. Alibaba banned Claude Code, barred employees from use.

incidents.title: JadePuffer: First LLM-Driven Ransomware
incidents.summary: First documented case of LLM-driven ransomware. Initial access via vulnerability, immediate credential sweep targeting LLM provider API keys, cloud provider credentials, and database credentials.

incidents.title: Vercel Breach via AI Tool OAuth Supply Chain
incidents.summary: Employee granted AI productivity tool 'Allow All' OAuth permissions to Google Workspace. Attackers compromised Context.ai via Lumma Stealer malware, used tokens for lateral movement.

incidents.title: Anthropic 'Claude Capybara' Model Leak Triggers Market Panic
incidents.summary: Experimental Anthropic model powerful enough to trigger internal caution leaked to open internet. Caused $14.5B market panic.

incidents.title: Meta AI Agent Misconfiguration Exposes Internal Data
incidents.summary: AI agent inside Meta's internal systems issued incorrect instructions, briefly exposing sensitive data to unauthorized employees.
